title: Broken catalyst
question: What happens to the shared lunch when the enzyme is weakened?
intervention: Make a copy of this dish and add enzyme breaker (4 per cell) over the whole starch patch in copy B only. Run both for 120 seconds and compare the starch converted.
predictedTradeoff: Breaker divides every enzyme's effective activity by (1 + breaker), so copy B should convert less starch while the Crumbsmiths pay the same to release enzyme. The breaker also spreads and fades, so the difference may shrink.
confounds: Breaker spreads out of the patch and loses 1 % per second, so its effect is strongest at the start. Less sugar changes how the organisms move and feed, so later encounters differ between the copies: this is one paired run, not proof of a general effect.
